_note: Frozen benchmark catalogue. The pins key selects npm stable releases through each pinned version. pypiPins selects PEP 691 Simple JSON files uploaded by the pinned release's last upload timestamp, fetched from /pypi/{name}/{version}/json. PyPI capture sidecars record the source, media type, cutoff, and file count. task gen-bench-corpus refreshes captures deliberately. Upstream yanks, metadata edits, and deletions can change a recapture, so committed bytes are the measurement authority. npm omits prereleases and unused operational fields. PyPI preserves retained file entries and filters the versions listing, dropping the changing _last-serial. Simple HTML and legacy project JSON are not benchmark inputs. smokeNames supplies live version-oracle names. This is not a package-manager project and Renovate does not update it.
